input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship sales-agent (allocate.py row 2; ai-bookkeeper row 1 had a 0h-old open PR): next item (1), round 7 of the Enron reply-rule rounds tuned on 0*-6*, scored once on unread 7*.
errors: First draft of the veto block was written through a non-raw Python string, so one '\b' became a backspace byte in engine.mjs; caught by grepping for 0x08 before running anything.

First draft's 'not looking to' veto flipped one agent-written reply ('Not looking to cancel our contract') from not_interested to objection; caught by diffing all 792 agent-written replies before freezing.

portfolio-pages 'test' red on this PR from a pre-existing main breakage (concrete-maturity FAQ not visible, #14766; fix in #14774); the job log tail (5,000 lines) did not reach the failure and the full-log host is blocked by the proxy, so it was reproduced locally with pull_request env.

doc_friction.issue: Rounds 3-6 say the blind reader had 'the same instructions' but the instructions were never saved; I had to reconstruct them from the method paragraphs (now eval/enron-labels/READER.md).
The fetch recipe checks out two halves; each round adds one, and nothing says the 8-half checkout is ~3.1 GB and takes ~10 minutes; worth saying before a session plans its time.

Rewriting a 'next:' block by regex can swallow the comment lines that sit between entries; I did and restored them. A promptctl/allocate helper that rewrites one venture's next: safely would remove the trap.

faq-visible (and other hygiene checks) are fatal only on pull_request events, so a venture can land on main with the check red and every later PR inherits the failure; a local run without GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request passes and hides it. Worth a line on reproducing with that env.

deviations.why: The default is to land a working slice that moves the milestone; the honest fresh score showed no gain, so the slice that landed is the measurement and the conclusion that rule rounds have stopped paying, not a better number.
deviations.did: Shipped round 7's rules (gains on read halves, no regressions), its blind fresh score of ~0, the duplicate-text measurement, the reader brief file, and a rewritten next: that stops further rule rounds.
deviations.result: Next runs are pointed at the away policy, a second reader, de-duplication and real outreach replies instead of round 8.

notes: Method: round-6 stops on 7* saved unread before any rule change; rules frozen at engine.mjs sha256 52f6408406d0 (commit efbba2c2d); union of round-6/round-7 stops on 7* (90) shuffled seed 20261114 and labelled once by a separate agent from READER.md. Fresh 7*: round 6 49/38/3 (4.0 per 1,000), round 7 49/37/3 (3.9). Tuning: 6* wrong 41->17, 5* 45->32, 0*-4* 33->28, one right lost (reader conflict on a duplicated message). Duplicates: 43 of 88 round-6 stops on 6* and 49 of 90 on 7* share text with earlier halves' stops. Checks run here: node --test in ventures/sales-agent 471 pass; run_venture_tests.py sales-agent ok; opt-out recall 115/119 same misses before/after; 792 agent-written replies no category change; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links ok; venture-preflight result in PR body. CI: every check green except portfolio-pages 'test' (twice), reproduced locally with GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request: the one failure is faq-visible.test.mjs on ventures/concrete-maturity/index.html (FAQPage JSON-LD with no visible copy), inherited from main via #14766 and fixed in the open PR #14774; it is fatal only on pull_request events, so main's push runs passed. Without that env the full platform/pages suite passes on this branch. Merged with that one red check, reason recorded here.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an ML engineer reading ~110 wrong stops, writing and checking ~30 vetoes, running the blind protocol and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
